findings.title: A single failed backend switch permanently corrupts backend-management state (IN_SET_CONTEXT stuck True; HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND left at the bad value; BACKEND_WARNING cleared)
findings.repro:
env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp
from hypertools.plot import backend as B
data = [np.random.default_rng(1).standard_normal((30, 4))]
hyp.set_interactive_backend('bogus')          # accepted silently (see 003)
try:
    hyp.plot(data, animate=True, duration=1, frame_rate=5, show=False)
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e).__name__, e)
print('IN_SET_CONTEXT =', B.IN_SET_CONTEXT)   # True -- leaked forever
print('HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND =', repr(B.HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND))  # 'bogus'
fig = hyp.plot(data, animate=True, duration=1, frame_rate=5, show=False)
print('silently succeeded on current backend:', type(fig).__name__)
EOF
findings.expected: The failed switch raises, and hypertools' state is restored: IN_SET_CONTEXT back to False, HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND back to its previous (working) value, so later plots behave normally (or keep raising the SAME clear error)
findings.actual:
HypertoolsBackendError: Failed to switch the plotting backend to bogus. You may be missing required dependencies, or this backend may not be available for your system
IN_SET_CONTEXT = True
HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND = 'bogus'
silently succeeded on current backend: HyperAnimation  -- and t06 (docstring examples verbatim, Tk-less machine): post-example-1 state: IN_SET_CONTEXT = True | HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND = 'TkAgg'

findings.title: set_interactive_backend performs no validation: 'bogus', None, 42, lists, bytes are all silently accepted and coerced to garbage backend strings
findings.repro:
env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import hypertools as hyp
from hypertools.plot import backend as B
for bad in ('bogus', None, 42, ['plotly'], b'plotly'):
    hyp.set_interactive_backend(bad)
    print(repr(bad), '->', repr(B.HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND))
EOF
findings.expected: Unknown backend names raise (or at least warn) at set time, naming valid options; None either resets to auto-detection or raises TypeError
findings.actual:
'bogus' -> 'bogus'
None -> 'None'
42 -> '42'
['plotly'] -> "['plotly']"
b'plotly' -> "b'plotly'"  (all silent; failure deferred to plot time)

findings.title: Nested set_interactive_backend contexts: inner __exit__ resets IN_SET_CONTEXT to False while the outer context is still active
findings.repro:
env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import hypertools as hyp
from hypertools.plot import backend as B
with hyp.set_interactive_backend('plotly'):
    with hyp.set_interactive_backend('matplotlib'):
        pass
    print('inside outer context, IN_SET_CONTEXT =', B.IN_SET_CONTEXT)
EOF

findings.title: The render-backend form set_interactive_backend('plotly'|'matplotlib') -- the only global way to prefer plotly -- is completely undocumented in the user-facing docstring/API docs
findings.repro: grep -n "plotly" /Users/jmanning/hypertools/hypertools/plot/backend.py | awk -F: '$1 > 922 && $1 < 1014'   # no hits inside the docstring; and: env MPLBACKEND=Agg HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND=plotly .venv/bin/python -W always -c 'import hypertools'
findings.expected: The docstring documents both accepted forms (matplotlib GUI backend keys AND the 'plotly'/'matplotlib' render preference), and the env-var/docstring cross-references say which form each mechanism accepts
findings.actual: Docstring text covers only 'TkAgg'-style matplotlib keys; UserWarning: failed to set matplotlib backend to backend specified in environment ('plotly'). Falling back to 'MacOSX'

findings.title: save_path='.html' (plotly interactive export) works but is undocumented; save-format support is asymmetric across backends and the save_path docstring only describes the matplotlib/FFMPEG story
findings.repro:
env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import hypertools as hyp
spiral = hyp.load('spiral')
hyp.plot(spiral, show=False, backend='plotly', save_path='/tmp/x.html')   # works
hyp.plot(spiral, show=False, backend='matplotlib', save_path='/tmp/y.html')  # raises
EOF
findings.expected: save_path docs state which extensions each backend supports (html = plotly only; png/pdf/... via matplotlib directly or via kaleido on plotly; gif/mp4 per backend animation exporters)
findings.actual: plotly: /tmp/x.html written (verified rendering in Chromium, play controls work); matplotlib: ValueError: Format 'html' is not supported (supported formats: eps, jpeg, jpg, pdf, pgf, png, ps, raw, rgba, svg, svgz, tif, tiff, webp)

findings.title: No public way to reset the render preference to auto-detection once set
findings.repro:
env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/jmanning/hypertools')
import hypertools as hyp
from hypertools.plot import backend as B
hyp.set_interactive_backend('plotly')
hyp.set_interactive_backend(None)  # intuitive 'reset' attempt
print('PREFERRED_RENDER_BACKEND =', repr(B.PREFERRED_RENDER_BACKEND))
print('HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND =', repr(B.HYPERTOOLS_BACKEND))
EOF
findings.expected: Some documented call restores the default auto-detect state

findings.title: set_interactive_backend('plotly') is silently ignored when plotly is not installed (auto falls back to matplotlib with no warning), while plot(backend='plotly') raises a helpful ImportError
findings.expected: A warning (at set or first-plot time) that the plotly preference cannot be honored because plotly is not installed
findings.actual: after set_interactive_backend('plotly') without plotly, auto returns: matplotlib.figure.Figure  (no warning, no error)
